description:
## Why

Pkilint half of PKIX-hbzo.1. Mirrors `.1.1` shape: thin pkix-difftest adapter over `pkix-pkilint-bridge`. Pkilint is DigiCert (Python, Apache-2.0); strong on S/MIME BR + ETSI.

## What

New file `pkix-difftest/src/lint_oracles/pkilint.rs` — `PkilintOracle` struct holding a `pkix_pkilint_bridge::PkilintBridge`. `impl LintOracle for PkilintOracle` (trait from `.1.1`) maps pkilint per-cert verdicts → `Vec<NormalizedFinding>` using `OracleSource::Pkilint`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix_pkilint_bridge` wired as workspace dep of pkix-difftest, gated behind the same `lint-oracles` feature added in `.1.1`.
- [ ] `PkilintOracle` impl in `lint_oracles/pkilint.rs`.
- [ ] Unit tests against tiny in-tree fixture certs.
- [ ] One integration test gated on real `pkilint` binary present.
- [ ] `cargo build --features lint-oracles` and `cargo clippy --features lint-oracles -- -D warnings` clean.

## Out of scope

- 3-way reconciliation (.1.3).
- Anything zlint-related (.1.1).

## Depends on

- **`pkix-pkilint-bridge`** (PKIX-jy95.8 — status=blocked as of 2026-05-12, must ship first).
- `.1.1` for the `LintOracle` trait + `NormalizedFinding` shape.

## Filed by

Decomposition of PKIX-hbzo.1 (2026-05-12). Cannot proceed until pkix-pkilint-bridge crate exists.
title: pkix-difftest: pkilint oracle adapter (lint-domain differential)
